steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Composition is the arrangement of visual elements within the picture plane — it guides the viewer's eye and creates meaning. | Key Fact: The rule of thirds divides the image into nine sections; placing focal points at intersections creates dynamic balance. | Key Fact: Negative space (the empty areas) is as important as positive space — it defines shapes and creates breathing room. | Key Fact: Foreground, middle ground and background create depth and lead the viewer into the picture.
